name: DogTin
shape_prompt: Stylized 3D game character, chunky vinyl-toy style, smooth sculpted rounded forms, quirky proportions. A cute wind-up tin toy dachshund: a long sausage-shaped tin body with a stripe and rivets, six toy wheels with hubs, a big wind-up key on its back, a boxy tin head with big round eyes and floppy ears, a small siren light on its head, a springy tail with a ball on the end. Kid-friendly, single object, no base.
texture_prompt: Bright saturated colours, smooth soft vinyl-toy finish, clean hand-painted look. Glossy blue tin body with a yellow stripe and silver rivets, GUARD painted on the side, red wheels with yellow hubs, brass wind-up key, blue tin head with big round black eyes and navy floppy ears, red and blue siren light, red ball on the tail.

assemble._note: Stand-in root 2 x 2 x 3 at the pivot, 1.5 studs above the ground; CanalTown anchors and moves it. Faces -Z (yaw set from the render).
